api_sources.description:
HTTP/REST APIs polled on a schedule by a generic Lambda and landed as gzipped JSON in raw/api/<name>/.
auth_type: none | bearer | api_key | basic
  - bearer : secret JSON {"token": "..."}
  - api_key: secret JSON {"api_key": "..."} sent in header `api_key_header`
  - basic  : secret JSON {"username": "...", "password": "..."}
pagination.type: none | page | offset | cursor | link_header
For paginated APIs set records_path (or return a top-level array) so an empty page stops the loop.

aws_region.description: AWS region to deploy into. Should match your Snowflake account region to avoid egress costs.

az_count.description: Number of availability zones to spread private subnets across.

crawler_schedule.description: Cron schedule for Glue crawlers (AWS cron syntax).

create_dms_service_roles.description: Create the account-global `dms-vpc-role` and `dms-cloudwatch-logs-role`. Set false if they already exist in the account.

create_vpc.description: Create a dedicated VPC. Set to false to reuse an existing one via existing_vpc_id / existing_private_subnet_ids.

database_sources.description:
Relational databases replicated into the raw zone as Parquet with AWS DMS Serverless.
Key = source name (raw/db/<name>/).
secret_arn must point to a Secrets Manager secret with JSON keys: username, password, host, port (and dbname for postgres/oracle/sqlserver).
engine: mysql | mariadb | postgres | aurora | aurora-postgresql | oracle | sqlserver
replication_type: full-load | cdc | full-load-and-cdc

enable_glue_crawlers.description: Create Glue crawlers that catalogue the raw zone (handy for Athena exploration and schema discovery).

enable_nat_gateway.description: Create a NAT gateway so resources in private subnets can reach databases over the internet. Not needed if sources are reachable via peering/VPN/TGW.

existing_private_subnet_ids.description: Existing private subnet IDs (used when create_vpc = false). Need at least 2 AZs for DMS.

existing_vpc_id.description: Existing VPC ID (used when create_vpc = false).

force_destroy_buckets.description: Allow terraform destroy to delete non-empty buckets. Keep false outside sandboxes.

noncurrent_version_expiration_days.description: Days before noncurrent object versions are deleted.

project.description: Short project name, used as a prefix for every resource.

raw_expiration_days.description: Days before raw objects expire. 0 disables expiration.

raw_transition_to_glacier_days.description: Days before raw objects move to Glacier Instant Retrieval.

raw_transition_to_ia_days.description: Days before raw objects move to S3 Standard-IA.

s3_sources.description:
External S3 buckets to copy into the raw zone with AWS DataSync.
Key = source name (used in paths: raw/s3/<name>/).
Cross-account buckets must grant the DataSync role (see output `s3_ingestion_role_arn`) read access in their bucket policy.

sftp_users.description:
Enables an AWS Transfer Family SFTP endpoint (partners/legacy file drops) when non-empty.
Key = user name, landing in raw/sftp/<user>/. Note: the server costs ~$0.30/hour while it exists.

snowflake_allow_write.description: Grant Snowflake write access to the curated bucket (needed for COPY INTO @stage unloads).

snowflake_external_id.description: STORAGE_AWS_EXTERNAL_ID from `DESC INTEGRATION <name>` in Snowflake. Leave empty on the first apply.

snowflake_iam_user_arn.description: STORAGE_AWS_IAM_USER_ARN from `DESC INTEGRATION <name>` in Snowflake. Leave empty on the first apply.

snowpipe_prefixes.description: Raw-zone prefixes that trigger Snowpipe notifications. Prefixes must not overlap. Empty string = whole bucket.

snowpipe_sqs_arn.description: notification_channel from `SHOW PIPES` / `DESC PIPE` (one SQS queue per Snowflake account & region). Enables S3 -> Snowpipe auto-ingest when set.

stream_sources.description:
Streaming / event sources. Each entry creates a Firehose Direct-PUT stream landing into raw/stream/<name>/.
Producers (apps, IoT, CloudWatch Logs subscriptions, EventBridge rules, Kinesis Data Streams...) push to it.

tags.description: Extra tags applied to every resource.

vpc_cidr.description: CIDR of the VPC created when create_vpc = true.
